source_audit: YouTube public watch URLs identified by indexed creator/description. 12 video titles confirmed in search metadata; two indexed pages returned no title, and these use explicitly flagged editorial descriptive titles. Live playability, embedding permissions, captions, and full spoken contents not verified. Round 2 appended 16 new direct video URLs with indexed title/creator descriptions, except one link supported by publisher-referenced podcast or syndicated metadata. No full-video inspection, availability or embed approval claimed; Haaga-Helia short dialogues have publisher CC BY-ND 4.0 and no subtitles. The Mari interview YouTube ID is linked from the publisher's podcast episode; original YouTube page title and embed not verified.
display_policy: Scores expert product fit, not measured learning outcomes; levels tentative where not explicitly asserted by creator
copyright: Do not download, mirror, re-upload or scrape YouTube videos/captions. Use direct URL and later official YouTube embedding/player API subject to platform terms; preserve branding and attribution.
score_calculation: Expert priority /100 from YKI theme 35, useful learning action 25, language fit 20, pedagogical taskability 10, provenance confidence 10; subjective
